title: achillea millefolium subsp. occidentalis
intro: Achillea millefolium subsp. occidentalis, commonly known as Western Yarrow, is a subspecies of the Yarrow plant, a flowering perennial native to North America. This plant has been used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including the treatment of digestive issues, reduction of inflammation, and antimicrobial effects. Western Yarrow's therapeutic actions include antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it useful for wound care, skin conditions, and menstrual issues. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as volatile oils, flavonoids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
